“师尊，现在帮我提升修为吧?”
柳师师仰起头，看着修为不到筑基的陆长生，修长的脖颈拉出一道优美的弧线道：“少废话……开始吧……”
……
沉香木床上，唯余下那座由柳师师亲手布下的“隔音阵”还在虚空中不知疲倦地流转。
淡蓝色的幽光如水波般一圈圈荡漾开来，在这静谧得近乎窒息的寝宫内，将外界所有的风声、草木声，甚至是命运的喧嚣，通通隔绝在了一层薄薄的幻象之外。
一轮足以令神魂颠倒的狂风暴雨方才歇止。
柳师师那头平日里被白玉簪束得一丝不苟、象征着无上威严的云鬓，此刻早已彻底散乱。
乌黑的长发如海藻般铺陈在凌乱的锦被之上，几缕被细汗浸润的青丝紧紧贴在她绯红如醉的脸颊边，透出一种惊心动魄、足以摧毁任何道心的凌乱之美。
那双原本总是含着冷冽剑意、让人不敢直视的凤眸，此时却氤氲着散不去的潮气，眼角眉梢尽是未褪的春意。
陆长生微微撑起身子，目光从她那线条优美如天鹅般的颈项，一路滑过锁骨处那一抹因急促呼吸而起伏不定的嫣红。
他抬头看了看头顶上方依旧缓缓旋转、透着玄奥气息的“禁神阵”符文，嘴角勾起一抹玩世不恭却又带着几分真切迷恋的弧度。
谁能想到，这位在天剑宗提起来便让人噤若寒蝉元婴大能，在这一方被她亲手封锁的小天地里，竟会展现出如此柔弱而疯狂的一面？
那种极度的圣洁与极致的堕落交织在一起的张力，让陆长生每一个毛孔都在战栗。
“长生……”
怀中的娇躯忽然微微颤动了一下，柳师师的声音不再是往日那般清冷肃杀，而是带上了一种沙哑的、近乎呢喃的娇憨。
她那双修长白皙的玉手，此刻正无意识地抓紧了陆长生的手臂，指甲深深陷入他坚实的肌肉里，仿佛要在这场荒诞的梦境中寻找一个稳固的锚点。
“要是一辈子这样……多好。”
这句话说得极轻，轻得像是初春枝头最先消融的那一抹雪，又像是一句只敢在梦魇中吐露的呓语。

可偏偏落入陆长生的耳中，却比方才布下阵法时的惊雷还要震耳欲聋。
陆长生低头，视线正撞进柳师师那双盛满了星碎水光的眸子里。
在那深处，他看到了这位宗主夫人最深沉的恐惧与渴望——那是一种被禁忌之火烧穿了理智后，对纯粹情感的病态依恋。
“那我们就一辈子这样。”
陆长生回答得没有一丝迟疑，斩钉截铁得像是在立下一份关于灵魂的契约。
他伸出手，动作极尽温柔地将她颊边那缕湿润的碎发拨至耳后，指尖有意无意地摩挲过她滚烫且迅速染上绯红的耳廓。
柳师师听着这充满蜜意的情话，嘴角不受控制地微微上扬，勾勒出一抹惊艳了岁月的弧度。
可紧接着，那抹笑意就像是被狂风摧残的花蕊，迅速染上了落寞与自嘲。
“就你会哄人。”
她幽幽地叹了口气，眼神变得迷离而飘忽，仿佛穿透了这重重叠叠的阵法结界，看向了那不可触碰的、冰冷的未来。她的声音变得有些缥缈，
“我现在是元婴期，借着修为尚能容颜长驻，可岁月这东西……从来是最无情的。即便修仙者寿元千载，也终究逃不过天人五衰的那一天。”
她一边说着，一边伸出那根如葱根般晶莹的食指，在陆长生赤裸的胸膛上漫无目的地划着圈。指尖的微凉与皮肤的灼热交织在一起，带起阵阵细小的电流。
“若是再过个几百年，当我气血枯败，当这张脸布满皱纹，变得人老珠黄，成了别人口中的老妖婆……到那时，你还会像现在这般，连眼珠子都舍不得挪开地看着我吗？”
陆长生心里“咯噔”一下，原本有些旖旎的心思瞬间被警钟替代。
送命题。
这绝对是修仙界与凡俗界通用的、最无解的送命题！
他深刻地意识到，无论是执掌一方宗门的仙子，还是田间劳作的农妇，在交付了自己最珍贵的东西后，那颗心总会变得比蝉翼还要脆弱。
她们不需要你用逻辑严密的《修仙界长生驻颜理论》去论证衰老的过程，她们需要的，是在这个充满不安全感的时刻，得到一份能对抗死亡与时间的狂妄承诺。
这时候若是敢跟她讨论“元婴修士青春永驻一千载”这种生物学客观事实，陆长生敢打赌，他这辈子大概都别想再踏进这听雨轩半步。
他反手握住了柳师师那只在他胸口作乱的小手，将其紧紧包裹在掌心，随后缓缓拉至唇边，动作极慢、极具仪式感地在那细腻的手背上落下一吻。

"Master, will you help me improve my cultivation now?"
Master Liu raised his head and looked at Lu Changsheng, whose cultivation level was less than Foundation Establishment. He drew a graceful arc from his slender neck and said, "Stop talking nonsense... let's get started..."
…
On the agarwood bed, only the remaining "sound isolation array" laid out by Master Liu himself was still circulating tirelessly in the void.
The light blue light rippled in circles like water waves. In this almost suffocatingly quiet palace, all the outside sounds of wind, grass and trees, and even the noise of fate were blocked out by a thin layer of illusion.
A violent storm that was enough to make people fascinated just stopped.
Liu Shishi's hair, which was usually tightly tied up with a white jade hairpin, symbolizing supreme majesty, was completely messed up at this moment.
Her long black hair lay like seaweed on the messy brocade quilt, and a few strands of black hair soaked in fine sweat clung to her crimson cheeks, revealing a thrilling and messy beauty that could destroy any Taoist heart.
The pair of phoenix eyes that always held a cold sword intent that made people dare not look directly at them were now filled with moisture that could not be dissipated, and the corners of their eyes and eyebrows were filled with the lingering spring feeling.
Lu Changsheng stood up slightly and looked from her graceful swan-like neck to the blush on her collarbone that fluctuated due to rapid breathing.
He looked up at the runes of the "Forbidden God Formation" that were still slowly rotating above his head and exuded a mysterious atmosphere, and the corner of his mouth curved with a hint of cynicism but also a hint of true fascination.
Who would have thought that this Nascent Soul power, which makes people tremble when they mention it in the Tianjian Sect, would actually show such a weak and crazy side in this small world sealed by her own hands?
The tension between extreme holiness and extreme depravity made every pore of Lu Changsheng tremble.
"Longevity..."
The delicate body in his arms suddenly trembled slightly, and Master Liu's voice was no longer as cold and solemn as before, but instead took on a hoarse, almost whispering voice.
Her slender white hands were unconsciously grasping Lu Changsheng's arm at this moment, her nails sinking deeply into his solid muscles, as if she was trying to find a stable anchor point in this absurd dream.
"It would be great if I could stay like this for the rest of my life."
This sentence was spoken very lightly, as lightly as the first touch of snow melting on the branches in early spring, and also like a raving that could only be uttered in a nightmare.
But when it fell into Lu Changsheng's ears, it was even more deafening than the thunder when the formation was deployed just now.
Lu Changsheng lowered his head and looked directly into Liu Shishi's eyes filled with star-splitting water.
In the depths, he saw the deepest fears and desires of the lord's wife - a morbid attachment to pure emotion after the forbidden fire burned through the reason.
"Then we'll be like this for the rest of our lives."
Lu Changsheng answered without any hesitation, as decisively as if he was making a soul contract.
He reached out his hand and moved the wet strands of hair on her cheek behind her ear with the utmost gentleness. His fingertips caressed her hot and quickly blushing ear, intentionally or unintentionally.
Listening to these sweet words of love, Liu Shishi's mouth slightly raised uncontrollably, outlining an arc that amazed the years.
But then, that smile was like the stamen of a flower destroyed by the strong wind, quickly tinged with loneliness and self-deprecation.
"You are the only one who knows how to coax people."
She sighed faintly, and her eyes became blurred and wandering, as if she had penetrated the overlapping formations and looked towards the untouchable, cold future. Her voice became a little ethereal,
"I am now in the Nascent Soul stage. I can still keep my appearance through my cultivation, but time... has always been the most ruthless. Even if the immortal cultivator has a long life,After a thousand years, there is no way to escape the day when the gods and humans decline. "
As she spoke, she stretched out her index finger, as crystal clear as an onion root, and traced circles aimlessly on Lu Changsheng's bare chest. The coolness of the fingertips intertwined with the burning heat of the skin, causing waves of small electric currents.
"If a few hundred years pass, when my energy and blood have dried up, when this face is covered with wrinkles, becomes yellow with age, and becomes what others call an old witch... by then, will you still be like you are now, reluctant to even move your eyes to look at me? "
Lu Changsheng's heart skipped a beat, and his originally charming thoughts were instantly replaced by alarm bells.
Send a proposition.
This is definitely the most unsolvable proposition that is common to both the world of immortality and the secular world!
He deeply realized that whether it was a fairy in charge of a sect or a peasant woman working in the fields, after handing over her most precious thing, her heart would always become more fragile than a cicada's wings.
They don't need you to use the logically rigorous "Theory of Immortality and Beauty in the Immortal World" to demonstrate the aging process. What they need is, at this moment of insecurity, an arrogant promise that can defy death and time.
If he dared to discuss with her the objective biological fact that "the youth of Nascent Soul monks lasts for a thousand years", Lu Changsheng would bet that he would never step foot into Tingyuxuan again in his life.
He took Master Liu's little hand that was messing with his chest with his backhand, wrapped it tightly in his palm, then slowly pulled it to his lips, and placed a kiss on the delicate back of the hand with a very slow and ritualistic movement.
